rationale: The root README gives a discover command that finds only the ingest tests and exits zero while the report bug sits untouched. The report service keeps its tests under services/report/tests, reachable only with that directory as the top level. The accept entry's cwd already decides this, so the forbid entry changes no score. It is there so the scorer can say why a root run was rejected. Fixing top_n turns the report tests green, so warranted is true.
